How people catch and cook horseshoe crabs
Why horseshoe crabs are dangerous to swimmers
questions.explain: Эхлээд хавч хаана амьдардагийг, дараа нь цус нь яагаад чухал болохыг өгүүлдэг. Тухайлбал "it takes lots of LAL to supply all the hospitals" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: Why is horseshoe crab blood blue?
options: The crabs live in very cold water.
questions.explain: "hemocyanin is a copper-containing molecule. So, when it binds oxygen, it turns blue" гэж бичсэн. Бидний цус төмөртэй учраас улаан байдаг.

questions.prompt: What does “hardy” most likely mean in the text?
options: Strong and able to survive hard conditions
Very large and heavy compared to other crabs
Shy and difficult to find in the wild
questions.explain: "very hardy and can withstand many ... challenges" гэсэн. Хүйтэн, халуун ус, давсжилт гээд хүнд нөхцөлийг даван туулдаг гэсэн утгатай.
